summary: Excellent, comprehensive test suite. Unit tests follow TDD with clear organization (classify → report → render → config → CLI), testing all core logic: secret classification into urgency buckets, report generation with sorting, multi-format rendering (markdown/JSON/summary), configuration validation with detailed error messages, and CLI argument handling with exit codes. Integration tests via act verify workflow execution on three fixture types (mixed, all-ok, warning-window), asserting exact output values and job success. Workflow structure tests validate YAML syntax, triggers, permissions, job dependencies, referenced paths, and actionlint. Strong edge case coverage: expired/warning/ok boundaries, configurable windows, invalid JSON/dates/policies, empty groups, required-by formatting, CLI overrides. Well-designed: logical test progression with descriptive names, excellent reusable fixtures (_sample_config, _write, _git_env), parametrization for efficiency, ANSI stripping for robust assertions. All requirements from task description are tested. Minor gaps: relies on external dependencies (act, docker, actionlint, PyYAML for workflow tests) and a few corner cases (e.g., extremely large rotation_policy_days) could be more thoroughly tested. Would reliably catch regressions.
